Binding decree 2410/2026, Article 4(1)(b), p. 5, and Article 7(13)–(14), p. 15, set ISEE no higher than €26,306.25 and ISPE no higher than €43,125.94; equality is allowed. The webpage summary agrees with €26,306.25, but its detailed income section says €26,306.35; the binding call controls the amount and comparator. The later 18 December 2026 ISEE/document date for first-year master students is not the 30 September scholarship application deadline. No 2027/28 call is inferred.
